input.title: Add TSV export support to the reports endpoint
input.body:
File: src/api/reports.ts

The reports endpoint currently supports CSV and XLSX formats for export. To align with the warehouse loader's requirement for tab-delimited files, add TSV (tab-separated values) as a supported export format. This change should include updating the `SUPPORTED_FORMATS` enum, modifying the `renderExport` function to handle TSV generation, and ensuring the API accepts and validates the new format in requests. The implementation should reuse existing logic where possible to avoid duplication.
